coordinates.object_orientation: Shell aperture plane approximately XY near Z=0; cap rises +Z; offset summit toward +Y. Internal shelf attached to +Y half of aperture beneath coiled side, free edge near X-axis. Reference plate roll is arbitrary; this is a consistent model coordinate choice, no anatomical compass claim.

concept.reason: Real UF146378 top/underside photos and institutional conspecific PRI70705 lateral thumbnail cover key structure; no synthetic concept needed. No denied image operation is bypassed.

extra_views.reason: Necessary to verify defining internal shelf and open aperture; neither canonical top nor positive-Z perspective exposes it. Retain all four standard views rather than sacrificing apex or profile evidence.

name: Trochita cap-shell fossil
target: Original genus fossil-form target retained: broad cap shell with offset spiral summit and internal shelf. Add the directly observed strong radial ribs, not a featureless conical limpet.

reference_specimens.primary: Trochita floridana UF146378: photographed exterior/top and underside, scale 5cm; Late Pliocene Tamiami Formation (Pinecrest Beds), Okeechobee County, Florida.
reference_specimens.comparison: Trochita floridana PRI70705: Pliocene Tamiami Formation (Pinecrest Beds), Sarasota County, Florida; reported height about2.5cm. Institutional scan thumbnail viewed solely for comparative lateral shell profile.
reference_specimens.scope: Original low-poly genus-level fossil study informed by two explicitly separate conspecific specimens; not an exact scan or UF height measurement, and not modern Trochita trochiformis.

must_have: Broad cap-shaped shell with a near-circular, slightly irregular scalloped basal rim; hollow underside
Offset low coiled summit and a shallow spiral shoulder/suture showing shell growth, not a centred rotationally perfect cone
About32–40 simplified broad radiating ribs continuing over the shell to scalloped margin; ribs follow growth and some diverge, not a gear with straight separate blades
Internal shelf covers roughly half the aperture, attached continuously along one side, with a nearly straight to gently curved free edge
Shelf is a broad sheet/partition, not Crucibulum-like central cup or tiny spiralling tube; remaining aperture stays deeply open
Real shell wall and shelf thickness visible at opening; modest height compared with wide footprint
must_not_have: No tall turret of multiple stacked whorls; no central summit hole
No flat solid disc or completely capped underside
No long siphonal canal, teeth along aperture, tentacles, operculum or substrate
No copied cracks, worn edge breaks, museum writing or source photo texture
No independent floating ribs/shelf that visibly disconnect from shell wall
morphology.simplification: Omit fine mineral speckle and microscopic growth increments. Retain low-frequency spiral shoulder, radial ribs, scalloped rim and internal shelf. Pale fossil tone is artistic.

scale.diameter_basis: UF146378 image: approximately304px shell diameter against318px white 5cm scale strip =>47.8mm; image estimate, not caliper measurement.
scale.height_basis: Explicitly inferred illustrative height, constrained by cap shape and comparative PRI70705 lateral view; NOT a measured height of UF146378. PRI70705 stated25mm is not transferred as UF measurement.
scale.scope: Genus-level specimen-informed study; do not advertise exact specimen dimensions or a morphometric replica.

acceptance_focus: Front -Y and side +X: shell-height/width ratio and offset summit remain cap-like, not tall cone
Top +Z: spiral growth/offset apex and coherent radial ribs clearly visible
Perspective (+X,-Y,+Z): main identification silhouette and ribbing legible at card scale
Necessary underside -Z: one-sided internal shelf with free margin and open residual chamber clearly exposed
No unintended mesh cracks or closed fake aperture; lip and shelf have genuine geometry
evidence_limits: UF146378 supplies exterior plan and interior shelf but no lateral height view; height is an explicit taxon-level inference using a separate conspecific comparison
No exact soft-body, shell colour in life, hidden internal coil or damage reconstruction is supported
Broad fossil context is Pliocene, not a co-occurrence scene with other assets
maker_workflow: 3–4 cheap gray views including underside before final render, save under private/
Four standard final views plus ONE targeted underside view, required because unique internal shelf cannot be judged from four above-side cameras. No turntable suite
Keep deterministic source self-contained; canonical helpers if used copied into source/deps with relative paths and sha256
Two isolated rebuilds, GLB/Khronos and existing geometry checks remain required; template helper is not QA
Same localdir through maker and QA; maker reports root then FINAL with no upload/cleanup
